title: 3 things I learned while my plane crashed
speaker: Ric Elias

sentences.en: Imagine a big explosion as you climb through 3,000 ft.
sentences.zh: 想像一个大爆炸 当你在三千多呎的高空

sentences.en: Imagine a plane full of smoke. Imagine an engine going clack, clack.
sentences.zh: 想像机舱内布满黑烟 想像引擎发出喀啦，喀啦， 喀啦，喀啦，喀啦的声响

sentences.en: It sounds scary. Well, I had a unique seat that day.
sentences.zh: 这声响很可怕 那天我的位置很特别，我坐在1D

sentences.en: I was sitting in 1D. I was the only one who could talk to the flight attendants.
sentences.zh: 我是唯一可以和空服员说话的人

sentences.en: So I looked at them right away, and they said, "No problem. We probably hit some birds."
sentences.zh: 于是我看着他们 他们说“没问题，我们应该只是撞上鸟了。”

sentences.en: The pilot had already turned the plane around, and we weren't that far.
sentences.zh: 机长已经把机头转向 我们离目的地很近

sentences.en: You could see Manhattan. Two minutes later, three things happened at the same time.
sentences.zh: 已经可以看到曼哈顿了 两分钟以后 三件事情同时发生

sentences.en: The pilot lines up the plane with the Hudson River.
sentences.zh: 机长把飞机对齐哈德逊河

sentences.en: That's usually not the route. (Laughter) He turns off the engines.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 他关上引擎

sentences.en: Now, imagine being in a plane with no sound.
sentences.zh: 想像一台没有声音的飞机

sentences.en: And then he says three words. The most unemotional three words I've ever heard.
sentences.zh: 然后他说了几个字 我听过最不带情绪的几个字

sentences.en: He says, "Brace for impact." I didn't have to talk to the flight attendant anymore.
sentences.zh: 他说“即将迫降，小心冲击” 我不用再问空服员什么了

sentences.en: (Laughter) I could see in her eyes, it was terror.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 我可以从她的眼神看到恐惧 人生结束了

sentences.en: Life was over. Now I want to share with you three things I learned about myself that day.
sentences.zh: 人生结束了 现在我想和你分享那天我所学到的三件事

sentences.en: I learned that it all changes in an instant.
sentences.zh: 瞬间内一切改变了

sentences.en: We have this bucket list, we have these things we want to do in life, and I thought about all the people I wanted to reach out to that I didn't, all the fences I wanted to mend, all the experiences I wanted to have and I never did.
sentences.zh: 所有那些我想连络却没有连络的​​人 那些我应该修补的围墙，人际关系 所有我想要经历却没有经历的事

sentences.en: As I thought about that later on, I came up with a saying, which is, "I collect bad wines."
sentences.zh: 之后我回想那些事 我想到一个说法 那就是“我收藏的酒都很差”

sentences.en: Because if the wine is ready and the person is there, I'm opening it.
sentences.zh: 因为如果酒已成熟，对象也有，我早就把酒打开了

sentences.en: I no longer want to postpone anything in life.
sentences.zh: 我不想再把任何事延后

sentences.en: And that urgency, that purpose, has really changed my life.
sentences.zh: 这种急迫的目的性 改变了我的生命

sentences.en: The second thing I learned that day -- and this is as we clear the George Washington Bridge, which was by not a lot -- (Laughter) I thought about, wow, I really feel one real regret.
sentences.zh: 正当我们通过乔治华盛顿大桥 那也没过多久

sentences.en: I've lived a good life. In my own humanity and mistakes, I've tried to get better at everything I tried.
sentences.zh: 虽然我犯了些错 但我的生命其实不错 我试着把每件事做得更好

sentences.en: But in my humanity, I also allow my ego to get in.
sentences.zh: 但因为人性 我难免有些自我中心

sentences.en: And I regretted the time I wasted on things that did not matter with people that matter.
sentences.zh: 我后悔竟然花了许多时间 和生命中重要的人 讨论那些不重要的事

sentences.en: And I thought about my relationship with my wife, with my friends, with people.
sentences.zh: 我想到我和妻子，和朋友 和人们的关系

sentences.en: And after, as I reflected on that, I decided to eliminate negative energy from my life.
sentences.zh: 之后，我回想这件事 我决定除掉我人生中的负面情绪

sentences.en: It's not perfect, but it's a lot better.
sentences.zh: 还没完全做到，但好多了 过去两年我从未和妻子吵架

sentences.en: I've not had a fight with my wife in two years.
sentences.zh: 过去两年我从未和妻子吵架 感觉很好

sentences.en: It feels great. I no longer try to be right; I choose to be happy.
sentences.zh: 我不再尝试争论对错 我选择快乐

sentences.en: The third thing I learned -- and this is as your mental clock starts going, "15, 14, 13."
sentences.zh: 当你脑中的时钟开始倒数 “15，14，13”

sentences.en: You can see the water coming. I'm saying, "Please blow up."
sentences.zh: 看到旁边的水位开始上升 心想“拜托爆炸吧”

sentences.en: I don't want this thing to break in 20 pieces like you've seen in those documentaries.
sentences.zh: 我不想这个东西碎成20片 像纪录片里那样

sentences.en: And as we're coming down, I had a sense of, wow, dying is not scary.
sentences.zh: 当我们逐渐下沉 我突然感觉到，哇 死并不可怕

sentences.en: It's almost like we've been preparing for it our whole lives.
sentences.zh: 就像是我们一直在为此做准备

sentences.en: But it was very sad. I didn't want to go; I love my life.
sentences.zh: 但很令人悲伤 我不想就这样离开，我热爱我的生命

sentences.en: And that sadness really framed in one thought, which is, I only wish for one thing.
sentences.zh: 这个悲伤 的主要来源是 我只期待一件事

sentences.en: I only wish I could see my kids grow up.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能够看我的孩子长大

sentences.en: About a month later, I was at a performance by my daughter -- first-grader, not much artistic talent -- (Laughter) Yet!
sentences.zh: 一个月以后，我参加女儿的表演 － 她一年级，没什么艺术天份⋯⋯ ⋯⋯就算如此

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I'm bawling, I'm crying, like a little kid.
sentences.zh: 我泪流满面 像个孩子

sentences.en: And it made all the sense in the world to me.
sentences.zh: 让我的世界重新有了意义

sentences.en: I realized at that point, by connecting those two dots, that the only thing that matters in my life is being a great dad.
sentences.zh: 把这两个事件连上 其实我生命中唯一重要的事 就是成为一个好父亲

sentences.en: Above all, above all, the only goal I have in life is to be a good dad.
sentences.zh: 比任何事情都重要 我人生中唯一的目标

sentences.en: I was given the gift of a miracle, of not dying that day.
sentences.zh: 那天我经历了一个神迹 我活下来了

sentences.en: I was given another gift, which was to be able to see into the future and come back and live differently.
sentences.zh: 同时我得到另一个启示 像是看见自己的未来 再回来 改变自己的人生

sentences.en: I challenge you guys that are flying today, imagine the same thing happens on your plane -- and please don't -- but imagine, and how would you change?
sentences.zh: 我鼓励今天要坐飞机的各位 想像若是一样的事发生在你身上 － 最好不要 － 但想像，你会如何改变？

sentences.en: What would you get done that you're waiting to get done because you think you'll be here forever?
sentences.zh: 有什么是你想做却没做的 因为你觉得你会有其它机会做它？

sentences.en: How would you change your relationships and the negative energy in them?
sentences.zh: 你会如何​​改变你的人际关系 不再如此负面？

sentences.en: And more than anything, are you being the best parent you can?
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，你是否尽力成为一个好的父母？

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢各位。 （掌声）
